articles.summary: Braemar Hotels Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) ("Braemar" or the "Company") announced today that it has successfully refinanced its mortgage loan for the 170-room Ritz-Carlton Lake Tahoe in Truckee, California, which had an existing outstanding balance of $43.4 million, a floating interest rate of SOFR + 3.25% and a final maturity date in January 2027. The new loan totals $60.0 million with an additional $15.0 million available to be drawn in the future subject to certain conditions, has a three-year initial term with two one-year extension options and provides for a floating interest rate of SOFR + 2.65%. With this financing now in place, the Company's next hard debt maturity is not until December 2028. "We are pleased with the execution of this refinancing, which extends the debt maturity on one of our premier luxury assets and capitalizes on tighter interest rate spreads in the market," said Richard J. Stockton, President and Chief Executive Officer. About Braemar Hotels
articles.title: BRAEMAR HOTELS & RESORTS ANNOUNCES REFINANCING OF THE RITZ-CARLTON LAKE TAHOE

articles.summary: Braemar Hotels Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) ("Braemar" or the "Company") announced today that it has successfully closed a new $358.0 million CMBS loan secured by The Ritz-Carlton St. Thomas, The Ritz-Carlton Reserve Dorado Beach, The Notary Hotel and Sofitel Chicago Magnificent Mile. The loan is interest-only, has a two-year initial term with three one-year extension options, subject to certain conditions, taking the final maturity to November 2031 and provides for a floating interest rate of SOFR + 2.37%. The new loan replaces two existing CMBS loans with combined outstanding balances of approximately $290.4 million as of September 30, 2026. The loan secured by The Ritz-Carlton St. Thomas, with a balance of approximately $80.5 million, carried a spread of SOFR + 4.91% and had a final maturity of August 2029. articles.summary: Braemar Hotels Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) ("Braemar" or the "Company") announced today that it has closed on the previously announced sale of the 210-room Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale for $372 million ($1.8 million per key), subject to customary prorations and adjustments. Including anticipated capital expenditures of $23 million, the sale price represents a 5.8% capitalization rate on net operating income and a 15.0x Hotel EBITDA multiple for the trailing 12 months ended September 2026. "I am extremely pleased with our investment in the Four Seasons Scottsdale," said Richard J. Stockton, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Having acquired the property in 2022, this transaction further demonstrates our acquisition team's ability to source and underwrite attractive opportunities, in addition to our asset management team's ability to implement deliverable growth strategies.
